title: accurate hitbox copper golem statue
description: A copper_golem_statue model that looks more like its actual hitbox
body:
# accurate hitbox copper_golem_statue This resource pack changes the copper_golem_statue(pose:standing) model to look more like its actual hitbox. Useful for checking the hitbox when using copper_golem_statue for entity alignment and similar purposes. (As a side effect, the copper_golem model is also changed to a box shape.)
(The EMF mod is required.)
![All poses](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2UEAHFdj/images/f6ccbca7806ac0103dff2d0060683a186c47a5e2.png) ![All statues](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2UEAHFdj/images/fb7d780d2e4a395fef1bf447f3fd58a3d9abd032.png)
